title: Geologic map of the Stallsville quadrangle, Dorchester and Charleston Counties, South Carolina
citation: Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., Jr., 1984, Geologic map of the Stallsville quadrangle, Dorchester and Charleston Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQ-1581, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 3 is OCR of the full map sheet; the text column is clean. Pages 1-2 are the cover and a standard symbol sheet. Symbols for Qal, Qhm, Qht, Qhec are printed with their descriptions; others come from text or the auger log (OCR Olf/Qic/QIs read as Qlf/Qlc/Qls, flagged inferred). Auger-hole log header elevations could not be matched reliably to holes (7 elevations, garbled labels) and were not recorded; log intervals are not legible. Parkers Ferry thickness not given.
